label: Send
gloss: notify, route, or deliver to a person, queue, or channel
why: When a run cannot finish on its own, a person has to be told, and told with enough context to act. A send delivers a message to a named owner with the record filled in. At Beacon, an invoice priced over its PO is not paid; the Procurement Lead gets a message that names the invoice so they can check the PO price.
cue: a send with no recipient rule is a guess; the routing rule belongs in a lookup, not in the message
task: Tell the Procurement Lead about INV-1: send them a message whose subject names the invoice number and whose body says why it is on hold.

config.subject: Price check on {{invoiceNumber}}
config.body: Invoice {{invoiceNumber}} for {{invoiceTotal}} against PO {{poNumber}} is on hold: {{reason}}. Please verify the PO price.

notes: To: a named owner from the world, not a guess.
Subject and body are templates: {{invoiceNumber}} fills in from the record.
A send does not end the record; steps after it still run.

checks.label: The Procurement Lead gets a message that names INV-1

dialect.powerAutomate: 'Send an email (V2)', 'Post message in a chat', or 'Create item' in a queue list
dialect.powerAppsCopilot: a Copilot Studio message node, or a notification from the app
dialect.make: an Email / Slack / HTTP module on the route
dialect.n8n: a Send Email, Slack, or HTTP Request node
dialect.zapier: an action step to Gmail, Slack, or a webhook
dialect.python: smtplib or requests.post to the channel's API
